verdict.rationale: Supermemory provides tenant isolation via 'container tags' as hard namespace boundaries and key-gated API/OAuth access (bearer auth on api.supermemory.ai, OAuth for MCP), which gives coarse-grained control over which tenant's memory is read/written. However there is no documented role-based access control, granular read/write policies, or audit logging of access events. Missing for 10: explicit RBAC/roles system, configurable ACL policies beyond tenant scoping, and any audit-trail/logging capability for governance review.
